metadata.description: The merge-queue e2e ratchet: the suites of this project that passed two consecutive e2e-nightly runs. ci.yml's e2e-queue lane runs each one as its own job in the merge queue whenever this project is affected, and e2e-nightly.yml leaves every suite listed here out of its matrix. A suite joins by being added to dependsOn (a target of this project) once green on two consecutive nightlies, and never moves back. Running this target runs them all.
